title: Scalable Bayesian Network Structure Learning Using Tsetlin Machine to Constrain the Search Space
new_feature: A parents-children BN structure learner that trains a Weighted TM per target variable, ranks variables by clause frequency x total absolute clause weight, keeps the top-2, and runs a fixed small number (~16) of CI tests per target, giving linear complexity vs PC/MB-based methods.

extraction_notes: Tables 4-7 and 11 extracted in full (7 networks x 5 methods). Appendix Tables 8-10 (missing nodes, missing edges, wrong edges) not extracted. Text says 'six benchmark Bayesian networks' but Table 3 lists seven; all seven used. Split marked 'train' because structure metrics are evaluated against the ground-truth DAG from the full sampled data (the 80/20 split only applies to WTM training). Train/test sizes 4000/1000 derived from stated 80/20 of 5000. Table 4 Munin1 numbers printed with Indian digit grouping in prose (6,77,727). Prose ranges (e.g. 'recall 0.81-0.40', 'higher than the initially stated range') are loosely worded; table values used throughout.
